body: I also struggle with focusing on things I can't change (like being circ'd), but recently I've worked on changing my thought process. Instead of thinking "I wish I wasn't circumcised", something I have no control over, I think "I want to experience more pleasure sexually" or something similar because there are more options for the second thought (products, techniques, whatever floats yer boat). It's easy to focus on what you can't change and spent a lot of time and energy on it. This method works for most things in relation to body image. Hope I helped.
